name: Abyssal Ashes
note: Dropped from killing abyssal demons, though it currently has no stated crafting use.

name: Abyssal Spine
note: Dropped from abyssal demons and used as a key material for crafting the abyssal whip.

name: Adamantite Ore
note: Mined from adamantite ore nodes and smelted with coal in a blast furnace to produce adamant bars.

name: Animal Bone
note: Retrieved from killing animals like cows, deer, and sheep, and used as a crafting material for weapons, armour, construction, and potions.

name: Animal Hide
note: Gathered from animals like cows, deer, and wolves, and put into a tannery to create leather.

name: Antler
note: Obtained by killing deer and used in crafting drinks, weapons, and armour at facilities like the Blacksmith's Bench and Fletching Bench.

name: Ascension Core
note: Crafted at the Mystic Forge, or rewarded from Nightmare Crucible instances, to upgrade masterwork weapons and vestiges to the next power level.

name: Ascension Shard
note: Used to craft ascension cores, which in turn upgrade masterwork weapons into stronger forms.

name: Black Dragon Hide
note: Obtained from defeating black dragons and processed at an advanced tannery into black dragon leather.

name: Black Metal Scraps
note: Dropped by Black Knights and combined with coal at a blast furnace to create black metal bars.

name: Black Salvage Pile
note: Dropped by Black Knights and combined with coal in a blast furnace to create black metal bars.

name: Blue Dragon Scale
note: Dropped by blue dragons and ground at a grindstone to produce blue dragon scale dust.

name: Blurite Ore
note: Mined from blurite ore nodes in the Takla Kara vault and smelted at a furnace to create blurite bars.

name: Bronze Salvage Pile
note: Obtained from Metal Salvage sources; nine piles can be smelted together at a furnace to produce a bronze bar.

name: Clay
note: Mined from clay nodes near water sources and used as a crafting material for pottery and construction.

name: Coarse Animal Fur
note: Gathered by defeating kebbits and rats or from bird nests, and used as a crafting ingredient for armour pieces and construction items.

name: Copper Ore
note: Mined from copper deposits, mainly in the Fractured Plains, and smelted with tin ore to produce bronze bars.

name: Corpse Cotton
note: Dropped by zogres or harvested from corpse cotton plants, and spun at a spinning wheel into fine thread.

name: Crucible Engram of Betrayal
note: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible, obtained by defeating various mini-bosses.

name: Crucible Engram of Helplessness
note: Obtained by defeating various mini-bosses and used to enter the Nightmare Crucible.

name: Crucible Engram of Humiliation
note: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible, obtained by defeating various mini-bosses.

name: Crucible Engram of the Hounded
note: Obtained by defeating various mini-bosses and used to access the Nightmare Crucible.

name: Desert Weed
note: Picked from plants in the Umbral Sands or farmed, then processed at a spinning wheel into desert thread.

name: Diamond
note: Obtained by mining coal nodes at level 16 Mining with the Gem Prospector perk, used in jewellery-making and weapon enhancement.

name: Dire Wolf Hide
note: Obtained by defeating dire wolves and processed at a tannery into dire wolf leather, or used in construction.

name: Draconic Leather Scraps
note: A crafting material combined at a tannery to produce draconic leather.

name: Dragon Blood
note: Harvested from dragons and dragonwolves, and used as a tanning agent at the tannery.

name: Dragon Tooth
note: Mined from a dragon skull in the Stormtouched Highlands or dropped by lesser dragons, used to craft the Challenge Horn for the Dragon Slayer quest.

name: Dragonstone
note: Obtained by mining adamantite and runite ore nodes with the Gem Prospector perk, used in jewellery and weapon recipes.

name: Ectoplasm
note: Obtained by killing aggressive spirits like lost souls or processing withered hearts in a kiln, used in construction, artisan, and fletching recipes.

name: Elder Curiosities
note: Dropped by KotHaar sentinels or found in Umbral Sands chests, ground at a grindstone to produce ground obsidian.

name: Feathers
note: Obtained by killing birds like chickens and terrorbirds, used as an essential component for fletching arrows.

name: Fleece
note: Obtained by killing sheep, rams, and goats, and processed into wool thread at a spinning wheel.

name: Garou Artefact
note: Found in Umbral Sands and sold to merchants for garou chits, or crafted into Lunar Garou armour at an Armour Bench.

name: Garou Chit
note: Currency used by the Moon Garou in Umbral Sands, obtained from chests, quests, or selling items to garou merchants.

name: Gold Ore
note: Mined from deposits primarily in Bloodblight Swamp and smelted at a furnace to produce gold bars.

name: Gold Salvage Pile
note: Obtained from Metal Salvage drops; nine piles are smelted together in a furnace to create a gold bar.

name: Greater Kalphite Wing
note: Dropped by kalphite guardians and queens, processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

name: Green Dragon Hide
note: Obtained from felled lesser green dragons and tanned at a tannery to create green dragonhide leather.

name: Gypsum
note: Mined from gypsum nodes in the Umbral Sands and ground into ground gypsum at a grindstone.

name: Iron Ore
note: Mined from deposits and smelted into iron bars, or combined with coal to create steel bars.

name: Iron Salvage Pile
note: Nine piles can be smelted together in a furnace to produce a single iron bar.

name: Kalphite Wing
note: Dropped by kalphite soldiers and processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

name: Limestone
note: Mined from limestone rocks in the Dowdun Reach region, typically near water, and processed into ground limestone at a grindstone.

name: Magic Logs
note: Harvested from magic trees with a Rune Logging Axe or better, used as a crafting material at the Mystic Forge and Fletching Bench.

name: Maple Sap
note: Gathered from chopped maple trees and cooked at a campfire or grill into maple syrup from Cooking level 41.

name: Mithril Ore
note: Mined from mithril deposits and smelted with coal in a blast furnace to produce mithril bars.

name: Mithril Salvage Pile
note: Combined with coal in a blast furnace to create mithril bars, obtained from reward packs and Metal Salvage drops.

name: Monstrous Fang
note: Obtained by defeating an abyssal demon, used as a crafting material for an Abyssal Demon Trophy through Construction.

name: Mystic Fibres
note: Obtained by opening Zamorakian mage packs and spun into mystic thread at a spinning wheel.

name: Obsidian Device
note: Dropped from kot packs from KotHaar sentinels or Umbral Sands chests, processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

name: Primordial Heart
note: Dropped by nature spirits during the Wild Hunt quest, tradeable to Vannaka for soul fragments.

name: Ram Horn
note: Obtained by defeating rams in the Stormtouched Highlands, used in blacksmithing, fletching, brewing, and construction recipes.

name: Red Dragon Hide
note: Obtained from red dragons and processed at a tannery into red dragonhide leather.

name: Ruby
note: Obtained by mining mithril ore with the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining, used to craft enchanted jewellery.

name: Runite Ore
note: Mined from runite ore nodes in the Scorned Wilderness and combined with luminite ore in a blast furnace to produce rune bars.

name: Sandstone
note: Mined from sandstone rocks across various regions, used as a building material for construction alongside stone and granite.

name: Shrapnel
note: Drops from enemies that inflict Bleed status, used to craft weapons and potions at various crafting stations.

name: Silver Ore
note: Mined from nodes primarily in the Bloodblight Swamp and smelted into silver bars at a furnace.

name: Silver Salvage Pile
note: Dropped from Metal Salvage; nine piles are smelted together at a furnace to produce one silver bar.

name: Small Animal Fang
note: Dropped by kebbits, rats, and wolves, crafted into fang arrows, daggers, infusions, and potions across various workbenches.

name: Spectral Chinchompa Skull
note: Obtained by defeating spectral chinchompas during the quest Things That Go Boom In The Night, delivered to Vannaka to complete it.

name: Steel Salvage Pile
note: Combined with coal in a blast furnace to produce steel bars.

name: Stone
note: A fundamental crafting and building resource used extensively across construction projects and item manufacturing.

name: Stunted Kalphite Wing
note: Obtained by defeating kalphite workers, ground at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

name: Swamp Tar
note: Gathered from the Whispering Swamp and processed in a kiln into adhesive, also used in chandelier and other crafting recipes.

name: Tin Ore
note: Mined from tin deposits and combined with copper ore at a furnace to create bronze bars.

name: Undead Bone
note: Drops from undead enemies in Fellhollow, processed at a grindstone or used in artisan recipes for weapons and armour.

name: Warped Feathers
note: Obtained from various Agility course reward packs, used to craft the Gyrhawk Amulet.

name: Weeds
note: Dug from empty farming patches using a spade, converted into compost via a compost bin.

name: Withered Heart
note: Drops from rotsworn creatures in Fellhollow, processed into ectoplasm at a kiln.

name: Bronze Bar
note: Smelted from 3 copper ore and 3 tin ore at a furnace, yielding 2 bronze bars.

name: Iron Bar
note: Smelted from iron ore at a furnace, used as a crafting ingredient for weapons, armour, and construction.

name: Steel Bar
note: Smelted from iron ore (or iron bars) with coal in a blast furnace, used for crafting weapons, armour, and tools.

name: Mithril Bar
note: Smelted from mithril ore (or salvage piles) with coal in a blast furnace, used for crafting weapons and armour.

name: Adamant Bar
note: Produced by smelting adamantite ore with coal in a blast furnace, used for crafting weapons and armour.

name: Rune Bar
note: Created by smelting runite ore with luminite ore in a blast furnace, used as a crafting ingredient for weapons and armour.

name: Black Metal Bar
note: Smelted from black metal scraps with coal at a blast furnace, used for black knight armour and weapons.

name: Gold Bar
note: Smelted from gold ore at a furnace, used for crafting armour sets including dragonkin mage and wild archer equipment.

name: Silver Bar
note: Smelted from silver ore at a furnace, used primarily as a crafting material for jewellery, armour, and decorative items.

name: Blurite Bar
note: Smelted from blurite ore at a furnace, used as a crafting material for crossbow components and ammunition.

name: Swamp Thread
note: Obtained by spinning swamp weed at a spinning wheel, used as a component in crafting weapons and armour.

name: Adhesive
note: Created by processing swamp tar in a kiln, used in crafting fuel pellets, hard leather, tanner's kits, and weapon barbs.

name: Vault Shard
note: Stone imbued with remnants of dragonkin magic, obtained from vault guardians in dragonkin vaults and used to craft weapons, armour, and equipment.
